newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia June merchandise imports A$6.846 bln.
newsitem.headline: Australia June merchandise imports A$6.846 bln.

text.p: Australia's international merchandise imports stood at A$6.846 billion in June from a reported A$6.456 billion in May, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.

This measure is compiled from information submitted by importers or their agents to the Australian Customs Service. It is not seasonally adjusted nor is it reported on the same balance-of-payments basis as the monthly balance on goods and services or quarterly current account data.
